Comment: Luminis glow for skin (bodies and faces). The glow comes from a glow layer: a texture (for example a PNG) where only the glowing parts are painted, in any colors, and everything else is transparent. Its colors are the glow colors; its transparency decides where it glows. Attach it with mtrl_luminis.py --glow-texture. Settings with intensity 0 never glow.

2657300338.Label: Glow tint
2657300338.Description: Multiplies the glow color. White keeps the glow layer's own colors.

2657300338.Label: Glow intensity
2657300338.Description: How bright the glow is. 0 turns Luminis off for this material. Lower values keep painted designs crisp; higher values bloom.

2469346156.Label: Dark start
2469346156.Description: Light level below which the glow is fully on (in dark mode). Lower = only glows in deeper darkness.

2469346156.Label: Dark end
2469346156.Description: Light level above which the glow is fully off (in dark mode). The gap between start and end sets how gradually it fades.

2469346156.Label: Light sensitivity
2469346156.Description: How strongly the mode applies. 0 = always on regardless of mode, 1 = full effect.

654612545.Label: Color source
654612545.Description: 0 = tint only, 1 = the skin's own color (including tattoos underneath), 2 = the glow layer's colors (default), 3 = rainbow along the texture. In-between values blend.

654612545.Label: Area mix
654612545.Description: 0 = react to light hitting the skin (shadows, facing a lamp), 1 = react to the area's overall brightness only (steady while turning). 0.5 is a good balance.

654612545.Label: Glow area
654612545.Description: Which parts of the skin glow.

Values.Label: Glow layer
Values.Description: Where the glow layer texture is painted (not transparent).

654612545.Label: Debug view
654612545.Description: Replaces the eye with diagnostic information. Set back to Off when done.

Values.Label: Glow mask
Values.Description: White where the mask allows glow.

Values.Label: Light level
Values.Description: Gray value of the light the shader measures.

Values.Label: Light gate
Values.Description: White = glow fully on, black = off.

Values.Label: Glow only
Values.Description: Shows only the glow, without the lit eye.

2602692533.Label: Detail
2602692533.Description: 0 = flat glow, 1 = the skin's own light and dark pattern shows through the glow.

2602692533.Label: Detail gain
2602692533.Description: Brightens the detail pattern. Raise it if detail makes the glow too dim.

2602692533.Label: Rainbow length
2602692533.Description: How many times the rainbow repeats down the texture (color source 3). Negative values reverse it.
